considerations: This requires the GitLab detections or an equivalent alert integration to write to SecurityAlert. Match the published titles or preserve them as part of the alert title.
The generic Onigmo native crash signal also covers other GitLab/Ruby vulnerabilities. Corroborate with the CI regex compilation stack, related GitLab detections, and the GitLab and Ruby builds.
A rejection or worker crash can be consistent with an attempt. Review host process, file and network timelines independently for evidence of code execution.
description: Find Sentinel alerts named after the six exploitation-attempt detections that GitLab publishes for CVE-2026-97229.

evidence.claim: GitLab Security publishes exploitation-attempt detections for vulnerable self-managed GitLab CE/EE. Its linked Onigmo guidance identifies compile-time crash frames together with regexp_matcher.rb as corroborating traces of the CI path.
evidence.location: Detecting CVE-2026-97229 Exploitation Attempts and linked Onigmo native worker crash detection

expected_output: One row per matching alert with the named detection, affected entity, alert ID and reporting product.

history.summary: Created evidence-backed hunt and validated all supported variants.

hypothesis: A GitLab-published exploitation-attempt detection can surface requests rejected by safeguards, crash evidence or a related error burst on self-managed GitLab.
performance: Time filter first, then table-specific predicates and a narrow projection.
scope: Evidence review, static checks, Microsoft Kusto syntax and schema analysis. Engine and workspace execution not run.
title: GitLab CVE-2026-97229 Vendor Detection Alerts

1.json:
SecurityAlert
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| extend DetectionName = replace_regex(tolower(AlertName), @"[^a-z0-9]+", "_")
| extend MatchedDetection = extract(@"(?:^|_)(onigmo_native_worker_crash|graphql_ci_?lint_hostile_regexp|ci_regexp_oversized_non_ascii_path|ci_regexp_guard_rejection|ci_lint_workhorse_worker_crash|ci_lint_scripted_client_error_burst)(?:_|$)", 1, DetectionName)
| where isnotempty(MatchedDetection)
| project TimeGenerated, MatchedDetection, AlertName, AlertSeverity, CompromisedEntity, ProductName, SystemAlertId
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| summarize Results = make_list(pack_all())
| project JSON = tostring(Results)
